title: Beyond Factual Accuracy: Evaluating Global Reasoning Integrity in RAG Systems with LogicScore
authors: Zhichao Yan; Yunxiao Zhao; Jiapu Wang; Jiaoyan Chen; Xiaoli Li; Ru Li; Jeff Z. Pan
